description: §5.2.3 (S435) — an inline block handler spanning several lines, newline-separated, with a `const` declaration and an `if` statement, runs every statement on each click. Pins "no line limit" and the function-body statement grammar of the block.
rationale: §5.2.3 (amended S435): the inline block's "statement list is logic context — the same statement grammar as a function body (§7.3): statements are separated by `;` or by a newline, and assignments, calls, `const`/`let` declarations, and `if`/loop statements are all legal. The block MAY span any number of lines." Three clicks: count 1, 2, 3; the `if` sets msg to "big" on the third.
